Product Details: 3M High Power Brake Cleaner (75 g) | Powerful and Effective Break Cleaning | Remove Brake Dust and Road Grime - Distributed/Packaged by 3M. Product Details: 3M High Power Brake Cleaner quickly and efficiently cleans dirt, dust, oil, tar, grease, brake fluid and other residue out of vehicle braking systems. A high-pressure delivery system flushes contaminants off the brake assembly with ease. Because this one product cleans away so many types of contaminants, it reduces the need to stock multiple cleaners. The cleaner is recommended for brake linings, shoes, drums, cylinders, calliper units, disc brake pads, and all other related parts. Newly cleaned brakes are less likely to squeal and chatter, making the car ride more enjoyable. The cleaner dries quickly and leaves no residue. 3M has made this brake cleaner easy to use. Simply hold the can approximately 12 to 24 inches away from the surface to be cleaned. Starting at the top, wash the contamination down and off the area being cleaned. If parts are extremely contaminated, repeat the application. Then wipe up the excess with a paper towel and dispose of it properly. Brake cleaner comes in a 14-ounce aerosol can that delivers a high-pressure spray to remove residue from brake assemblies. This formula contains 45% VOC. Keeping your brake components in top-working condition should be an important part of your ongoing vehicle maintenance. Under normal road conditions, residue builds up on vehicle braking systems. Using this brake cleaner is a simple step that can be taken to restore the cleanliness of the brakes.
